data.explanation: Both facts report the same value of 139.88 INR for the cost of acquisition of 46,131,800 equity shares by CA Swift Investments. Fact A specifies this occurred in the year preceding the prospectus, while Fact B presents it as the average cost as of the date of the prospectus, indicating no other acquisitions changed the average.
data.reconciliation: The weighted average cost for shares acquired in the last year (Fact A) is identical to the total average cost of all shares held (Fact B) because all 46,131,800 shares were acquired within that preceding year.
